qt: to the Commission Galato Alexandraki (ECR) Subject:

On 8 July 2026, the Commission escalated an infringement procedure against Greece in light of its continued failure to meet binding targets set by EU waste legislation. Greece did not meet the target of preparing 50 % of municipal waste for reuse and recycling, a target that should have been met back in 2020. The country also failed to meet targets for all packaging waste and glass during the period 2020-2023. This persistent lag raises questions about the effectiveness of national policies and of the European funds allocated to the sector. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.
How does it assess the effectiveness of EU-funded waste management projects in the country?
What specific corrective measures has it asked the Greek authorities to implement and what timeline have they been given, in view also of the stricter targets for 2025 and 2030?
